newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Five killed in Burundi attack -army.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in Burundi attack -army.

text.p: Five civilians were killed on Tuesday night when rebels attacked a northern suburb of the capital Bujumbura, an army spokesman said on Wednesday.
Lieutenant-Colonel Isaie Nibizi gave no further details on the attack in Kinama neighbourhood.
"The rebels killed five people in Kinama last night. The army intervened and chased the rebels," he said.
Some 150,000 people have died in ethnic violence in Burundi since 1993 after Tutsi soldiers murdered the first freely-elected President Melchior Ndadaye, a Hutu.
